protocol: Independently recompute the normalization ledger from the pinned source cross section, luminosity, branching fractions, multiplicities and signed generator-weight sums. Compare the applied factor and every delivered bin with the recomputation.

Check charge/channel accounting, cross-section units and perturbative order, generated-event versus sum-of-weight denominators, skim efficiencies and variation bookkeeping. Missing physics factors remain unknown.
Compare the normalization recomputation with both blinded re-derivations at the declared tolerance. Disagreement opens an RCA request; central-value agreement alone grants no physics certification.
Refuse certification by a reference that entered the fit or candidate selection input closure. Preserve source and held-out evidence boundaries.

Give every finding an evidence class (new_receipt, code_check, cited or opinion) and the receipt, check or locator IDs behind it. Only new_receipt, code_check or a typed discriminating-test request can block; cited claims and opinions stay advisory. Ask for the cheapest discriminating test that could invalidate the claim.
Report public rationales and located evidence. Never accept your own work, widen approval or erase an unresolved obligation.
